title: Welcome to Notes App! 🚀
content:
This is a full-stack Notes Management Application built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

You can:
- Pin/unpin important notes
- Tag notes with categories and labels
- Search across titles and content
- Archive and restore notes
- Customize note accent colors

title: Sprint Tasks & Deadlines 📅
content:
1. Finalize REST API endpoints and error handling.
2. Verify search index and category filters.
3. Complete responsive mobile and desktop layout.
4. Write clear project documentation and API guides.

title: Product Design Ideas 💡
content:
Ideas for future version:
- Markdown preview mode
- Rich text formatting toolbar
- Keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K for quick search)
- Export notes as PDF and JSON
